newsitem.title: USA: International Testing drops acquisition effort.
newsitem.headline: International Testing drops acquisition effort.

text.p: International Testing Services Inc said on Friday it was unable to complete the necessary financing to acquire MQS Inspection Inc and Cooperheat Inc from Praxair Inc.
International Testing said it assigned its contractual rights to the acquisition to International Industrial Services Inc for a $2 million fee.

"While we were disappointed that we were unable to conclude the financing, we are pleased that we were able to negotiate this payment to assist us with our lonstanding liquidity problems," John B. Connally III, the company's president, said in a news release.
Connally said International Testing was continuing negotiations about combining some or all of its operations into International Industrial.
International Testing Services is an environmental and safety company engaged in testing services for the petrochemical, refining and pipeline industries.
